name: Knave: 100 Classless Spells
attribution: Knave, copyright Ben Milton (questingbeast.com / questingblog.com). Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
usage_note: Use if you prefer level-less spells that scale with the caster. 'L' is a number equal to the caster's level. An item is an object able to be lifted with one hand; an object is anything up to human size. Unless otherwise noted, effects with ongoing duration last up to Lx10 minutes and have a range of up to 40 feet. A creature directly affected may make a save to avoid or reduce the effect. Entry 90 (Summon Idol) appears out of alphabetical sequence in the source between entries 89 and 91; preserved as published rather than resorted.

entries.name: Adhere
entries.effect: Object is covered in extremely sticky slime.

entries.name: Animate Object
entries.effect: Object obeys your commands as best it can. It can walk 15ft per round.

entries.name: Anthropomorphize
entries.effect: A touched animal either gains human intelligence or human appearance for L days.

entries.name: Arcane Eye
entries.effect: You can see through a magical floating eyeball that flies around at your command.

entries.name: Astral Prison
entries.effect: An object is frozen in time and space within an invulnerable crystal shell.

entries.name: Attract
entries.effect: L+1 objects are strongly magnetically attracted to each other if they come within 10 feet.

entries.name: Auditory Illusion
entries.effect: You create illusory sounds that seem to come from a direction of your choice.

entries.name: Babble
entries.effect: A creature must loudly and clearly repeat everything you think. It is otherwise mute.

entries.name: Beast Form
entries.effect: You and your possessions transform into a mundane animal.

entries.name: Befuddle
entries.effect: L creatures of your choice are unable to form new short-term memories for the duration of the spell.

entries.name: Bend Fate
entries.effect: Roll L+1 d20s. Whenever you must roll a d20 after casting the spell, you must choose and then discard one of the rolled results until they are all gone.

entries.name: Bird Person
entries.effect: Your arms turn into huge bird wings.

entries.name: Body Swap
entries.effect: You switch bodies with a creature you touch. If one body dies, the other dies as well.

entries.name: Catherine
entries.effect: A woman wearing a blue dress appears until end of spell. She will obey polite, safe requests.

entries.name: Charm
entries.effect: L creatures treat you like a friend.

entries.name: Command
entries.effect: A creature obeys a single, three-word command that does not harm it.

entries.name: Comprehend
entries.effect: You become fluent in all languages.

entries.name: Control Plants
entries.effect: Nearby plants and trees obey you and gain the ability to move at 5 feet per round.

entries.name: Control Weather
entries.effect: You may alter the type of weather at will, but you do not otherwise control it.

entries.name: Counterspell
entries.effect: Make an opposed Intelligence save against the Intelligence of the caster of a nearby spell. You may do this out of turn as a reaction, or against an ongoing magical effect. On a success, you may cancel the spell.

entries.name: Deafen
entries.effect: All nearby creatures are deafened.

entries.name: Detect Magic
entries.effect: You hear nearby magical auras singing. Volume and harmony signify the aura's power and refinement.

entries.name: Disassemble
entries.effect: Any of your body parts may be detached and reattached at will, without causing pain or damage. You can still control them.

entries.name: Disguise
entries.effect: You may alter the appearance of L characters at will as long as they remain humanoid. Attempts to duplicate other characters will seem uncanny.

entries.name: Displace
entries.effect: An object appears to be up to Lx10ft from its actual position.

entries.name: Earthquake
entries.effect: The ground begins shaking violently. Structures may be damaged or collapse.

entries.name: Elasticity
entries.effect: Your body can stretch up to Lx10ft.

entries.name: Elemental Wall
entries.effect: A straight wall of ice or fire Lx40ft long and 10ft high rises from the ground.

entries.name: Filch
entries.effect: L visible items teleport to your hands.

entries.name: Fog Cloud
entries.effect: Dense fog spreads out from you.

entries.name: Frenzy
entries.effect: L creatures erupt in a frenzy of violence.

entries.name: Gate
entries.effect: A portal to a random plane opens.

entries.name: Gravity Shift
entries.effect: You can change the direction of gravity (for yourself only) up to once per round.

entries.name: Greed
entries.effect: L creatures develop an overwhelming urge to possess a visible item of your choice.

entries.name: Haste
entries.effect: Your movement speed is tripled.

entries.name: Hatred
entries.effect: L creatures develop a deep hatred of another creature or group of creatures and wish to destroy it.

entries.name: Hear Whispers
entries.effect: You can hear faint sounds clearly.

entries.name: Hover
entries.effect: An object hovers, frictionless, 2ft above the ground. It can hold up to L humanoids.

entries.name: Hypnotize
entries.effect: A creature enters a trance and will truthfully answer L yes or no questions you ask it.

entries.name: Icy Touch
entries.effect: A thick ice layer spreads across a touched surface, up to Lx10ft in radius.

entries.name: Illuminate
entries.effect: A floating light moves as you command.

entries.name: Increase Gravity
entries.effect: The gravity in an area triples.

entries.name: Invisible Tether
entries.effect: Two objects within 10ft of each other cannot be moved more than 10ft apart.

entries.name: Knock
entries.effect: L nearby mundane or magical locks unlock.

entries.name: Leap
entries.effect: You can jump up to Lx10ft in the air.

entries.name: Liquid Air
entries.effect: The air around you becomes swimmable.

entries.name: Magic Dampener
entries.effect: All nearby magical effects have their effectiveness halved.

entries.name: Manse
entries.effect: A sturdy, furnished cottage appears for Lx12 hours. You can permit and forbid entry to it at will.

entries.name: Marble Madness
entries.effect: Your pockets are full of marbles, and will refill every round.

entries.name: Masquerade
entries.effect: L characters' appearances and voices become identical to a touched character.

entries.name: Miniaturize
entries.effect: You and L other touched creatures are reduced to the size of a mouse.

entries.name: Mirror Image
entries.effect: L illusory duplicates of yourself appear under your control.

entries.name: Mirrorwalk
entries.effect: A mirror becomes a gateway to another mirror that you looked into today.

entries.name: Multiarm
entries.effect: You gain L extra arms.

entries.name: Night Sphere
entries.effect: An Lx40ft wide sphere of darkness displaying the night sky appears.

entries.name: Objectify
entries.effect: You become any inanimate object between the size of a grand piano and an apple.

entries.name: Ooze Form
entries.effect: You become a living jelly.

entries.name: Pacify
entries.effect: L creatures have an aversion to violence.

entries.name: Phantom Coach
entries.effect: A ghostly coach appears until end of spell. It moves unnaturally fast over any terrain, including water.

entries.name: Phobia
entries.effect: L creatures become terrified of an object of your choice.

entries.name: Pit
entries.effect: A pit 10ft wide and Lx5ft deep opens in the ground.

entries.name: Primeval Surge
entries.effect: An object grows to the size of an elephant. If it is an animal, it is enraged.

entries.name: Psychometry
entries.effect: The referee answers L yes or no questions about a touched object.

entries.name: Pull
entries.effect: An object of any size is pulled directly towards you with the strength of L men for one round.

entries.name: Push
entries.effect: An object of any size is pushed directly away from you with the strength of L men for one round.

entries.name: Raise Dead
entries.effect: L skeletons rise from the ground to serve you. They are incredibly stupid and can only obey simple orders.

entries.name: Raise Spirit
entries.effect: The spirit of a dead body manifests and will answer L questions.

entries.name: Read Mind
entries.effect: You can hear the surface thoughts of nearby creatures.

entries.name: Repel
entries.effect: L+1 objects are strongly magnetically repelled from each other if they come within 10 feet.

entries.name: Scry
entries.effect: You can see through the eyes of a creature you touched earlier today.

entries.name: Sculpt Elements
entries.effect: All inanimate material behaves like clay in your hands.

entries.name: Shroud
entries.effect: L creatures are invisible until they move.

entries.name: Shuffle
entries.effect: L creatures instantly switch places. Determine where they end up randomly.

entries.name: Sleep
entries.effect: L creatures fall into a light sleep.

entries.name: Smoke Form
entries.effect: Your body becomes living smoke.

entries.name: Snail Knight
entries.effect: 10 minutes after casting, a knight sitting astride a giant snail rides into view. He is able to answer most questions related to quests and chivalry, and may aid you if he finds you worthy.

entries.name: Sniff
entries.effect: You can smell even the faintest traces of scents.

entries.name: Sort
entries.effect: Inanimate items sort themselves according to categories you set. The categories must be visually verifiable.

entries.name: Spectacle
entries.effect: A clearly unreal but impressive illusion of your choice appears, under your control. It may be up to the size of a palace and has full motion and sound.

entries.name: Spellseize
entries.effect: Cast this as a reaction to another spell going off to make a temporary copy of it that you can cast at any time before this spell ends.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries.effect: You can climb surfaces like a spider.

entries.name: Summon Cube
entries.effect: Once per second, (6 times per round) you may summon or banish a 3-foot-wide cube of earth. New cubes must be affixed to the earth or to other cubes.

entries.name: Swarm
entries.effect: You become a swarm of crows, rats, or piranhas. You only take damage from area effects.

entries.name: Telekinesis
entries.effect: You may mentally move L items.

entries.name: Telepathy
entries.effect: L+1 creatures can hear each other's thoughts, no matter how far apart they move.

entries.name: Teleport
entries.effect: An object disappears and reappears on the ground in a visible, clear area up to Lx40ft away.

entries.name: Thaumaturgic Anchor
entries.effect: Object becomes the target of every spell cast near it.

entries.name: Thicket
entries.effect: A thicket of trees and dense brush up to Lx40ft wide suddenly sprouts up.

entries.name: Time Jump
entries.effect: An object disappears as it jumps Lx10 minutes into the future. When it returns, it appears in the unoccupied area nearest to where it left.

entries.name: Summon Idol
entries.effect: A carved stone statue the size of a four poster bed rises from the ground.

entries.name: Time Rush
entries.effect: Time in a 40ft bubble starts moving 10 times faster.

entries.name: Time Slow
entries.effect: Time in a 40ft bubble slows to 10%.

entries.name: True Sight
entries.effect: You see through all nearby illusions.

entries.name: Upwell
entries.effect: A spring of seawater appears.

entries.name: Vision
entries.effect: You completely control what a creature sees.

entries.name: Visual Illusion
entries.effect: A silent, immobile, illusion of your choice appears, up to the size of a bedroom.

entries.name: Ward
entries.effect: A silver circle 40ft across appears on the ground. Choose one thing that cannot cross it: Living creatures, dead creatures, projectiles or metal.

entries.name: Web
entries.effect: Your wrists can shoot thick webbing.

entries.name: Wizard Mark
entries.effect: Your finger can shoot a stream of ulfire-colored paint. This paint is only visible to you, and can be seen at any distance, even through solid objects.

entries.name: X-Ray Vision
entries.effect: You gain X-Ray vision.
